phantasmon_events.trahison.say.phase.lob: Mystaria: The house is open. Nine bracelets, nine wrists. Come in, and choose your companions carefully.
phantasmon_events.trahison.say.phase.pro: Mystaria: You wake in the hall. I am Mystaria, the first ghost. Look at your bracelet: it is your life now.
phantasmon_events.trahison.say.phase.doo: Mystaria: The doors are waking. Pair or solo, red, green or blue: decide who goes where before they close. Whoever passes no door will not see the rooms.
phantasmon_events.trahison.say.phase.roo: Mystaria: The doors have closed. Three of you, one room, and the clock forgives nothing. Work together... for now.
phantasmon_events.trahison.say.phase.fre: Mystaria: The doors stand open again. Wander, talk, search. Walls hide secrets, and so do friends.
phantasmon_events.trahison.say.phase.vot: Mystaria: To the booths. Ally or betray: no one will know what you chose... until I say so.
phantasmon_events.trahison.say.phase.res: Mystaria: The booths are open. Every vote, every point, laid bare. Look at who is still smiling.
phantasmon_events.trahison.say.phase.fin: Mystaria: The last door waits. Nine points to open it. Which of you has earned them?
phantasmon_events.trahison.say.phase.end: Mystaria: It is over. The house falls silent, and I... I stay.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.thre:
Three worn dials, each numbered 0 to 9. Turn one by dragging around it, with the mouse wheel, the arrows or the arrow keys. Everyone in the group turns the same dials: listen to each other.

The right order is somewhere in the room.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.ring:
Concentric rings of worn symbols. Turn a ring by dragging it around the centre, with the mouse wheel, or with the arrow keys (up and down pick a ring, left and right turn it). Line up the right symbol of each ring on the marked radius at the top.

Turning one ring may turn others. Nobody tells you which: watch.

The sequence to show, from the outside in, is somewhere in the room.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.debu: A single button, for testing. Press it with the mouse, Enter or Space.

phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.keyp:
A wall keypad. Type the code with the keys or with the keyboard (digits, Backspace to erase, Delete to clear, Enter to confirm). Everyone in the group sees what is typed and any of you can press the keys.

A wrong code empties the display. Three wrong tries in a row lock the keypad for 10 seconds, then 20, then 40 if it happens again. The code is somewhere in the room.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.pick:
Objects are hidden in the room. Picking one up where you find it is enough.

The counter says how many have been picked up out of how many were hidden.
Pick the hidden objects up where you find them.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.code:
A terminal guesses a hidden combination. Type a try with the token keys (or the keyboard: 1 to 9 for symbols, 0 to 9 for digits; Backspace erases, Delete clears, Enter sends). Everyone in the group sees what is typed.

The terminal answers each try with two numbers: a filled disc for the tokens that are right and well placed, a ring for the tokens that are right but misplaced. It never says which ones. Nothing in the room tells the combination: reason from the history.

When a limit of tries is set, running out clears the history; the combination stays the same.
No try yet. Type a combination.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.wiri:
A panel of terminals. The numbered terminals on the left must each be joined to a coloured terminal on the right. A clue somewhere in the room says which colour goes with which number; each colour has its symbol (red triangle, green disc, blue square, yellow diamond, white ring). The clue may also be a text: "1 : red, 2 : blue...".

Drag from one terminal to a terminal on the other side to place a wire, or click one then the other. Drag a wire off its end to move it, or drop it in the void to remove it; right-click a terminal also removes its wire. A terminal holds one wire.

When every wire is placed the panel checks them: a wrong set is a short circuit: every wire drops and you start over.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.dex_:
A terminal of the portrait room. The code is the Pokedex number of each portrait, three digits each, in the order of the portraits (for instance 025 then 133 is 025133). The portraits are on the walls; a torn Pokedex page somewhere in the room lists numbers and names.

Type the code with the keys or the keyboard (digits, Backspace to erase, Delete to clear, Enter to confirm). Everyone in the group sees what is typed. Three wrong tries in a row lock the terminal for a while.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.unow:
A sentence in the Zarbi alphabet spells the code in digit words (ONE, TWO...). Read the wall text in the room: it is then copied above the keypad. The Zarbi key, a page that shows each glyph with its letter, is somewhere in the room.

Type the digits with the keys or the keyboard and confirm with Enter.
Read the Zarbi text on the wall first.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.weig: Put the pedestals in order. Click a pedestal, then another one: they swap places. The measures of each Pokemon are on the scale sheet in the room. The order goes from left to right, from the lightest (or the smallest) to the heaviest (or the tallest).
Now pick the one to swap with
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.pc_b: Tidy the box by a rule nobody tells you. The padlocked Pokemon are already in their right place: use them to guess the rule (it is about the Pokedex number, the weight, the height or the name, going up or down). Click a free Pokemon, then another one: they swap places. The box is done when every Pokemon follows the rule.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.cry_:
The console plays the cries of Pokemon. Click a Cry button to hear it, then click the Pokemon you think it belongs to: the Pokemon gets the cry's number. Click a numbered Pokemon with no cry selected to take its number back.

When every cry has a Pokemon, press Confirm. The console only says how many pairs are right, not which ones. Keys 1 to 4 play the cries, Enter confirms.
Click a cry to hear it.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.batt:
Your team (left) must knock out the opposing team (right) within the turns shown, with exactly the right actions. Each button is an attack: the type of the attack and its power. The Pokemon under your active one are reserves: click one to switch to it. An attack that is stronger against the target's type does more damage; the table shows which types do. A marked attack (triangle) always goes first.

The opponent always plays the attack shown as "Opponent next", and the same one in the same situation. If your team falls or the turns run out, the starting position comes back.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.type: Each lever is marked with a type. Pull them in the order where each type is strong against the next one (the sheet in the room says who beats whom). A wrong lever resets the chain. This is played in the world: click the levers.
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.thre:
Three levers stand in three corners of the room. Each must be held by a different player at the same time. Click a lever to engage it: it stays engaged for a few seconds, click it again to keep it so. A player holds only one lever at a time: engaging another lets go of the first.

The levers may have to be engaged in a certain order, and each one soon after the last. Engage one out of order, or too slowly, and they all let go. The three small lights say how many are engaged together.
Preview: in the room, the levers are clicked in the world

phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.slid:
A board of blocks that only slide along their own direction. Free the marked piece, the one with the lit rim, through the opening on the right.

Drag a block along its axis, or click it and use the arrow keys (Tab picks the next block). A block cannot cross another one.

Someone else may move blocks too: watch the board before you plan.

phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.rota:
Pipe tiles turn a quarter turn per click: left click or Enter turns clockwise, right click or the mouse wheel the other way, the arrow keys move the cursor.

Current enters on the left, in the marked row, and flows through branches that meet. Tiles it reaches light up. Close the circuit up to the lamp on the right.

A tile with a rivet is fixed: it is already right.
Bring the current to the lamp
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.safe:
A safe with a numbered dial. Turn the dial (drag it, mouse wheel, or the Left and Right keys) and listen: the safe clicks differently as you get closer to the number it wants, rings a bell when you are near, and clunks when you are on it.

When you are on the number, press Lock (or Enter). Each number must be reached turning the way the screen says, right first, then left, and so on. A wrong lock makes the safe forget the numbers found.

The lamp repeats what the sound says, if you cannot hear it.
Reach the next number turning right
Reach the next number turning left
phantasmon_events.trahison.minigame.twin:
Two terminals far apart each show half of the problem: a sequence of symbols, displayed in the room where the terminal is. What you type here is what the other terminal shows, and the other way round.

Two different players are needed, one at each terminal. Read your sequence aloud, type the one you are told, with the keyboard below (keys 1 to 9 and 0 also pick symbols, Backspace erases, Delete clears, Enter sends).

A right sequence locks your terminal. You cannot use both terminals yourself.
Use a terminal in the room to take its seat
